forum.title: STM32F303 process technology (nm)
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Wolfgang Metzler and welcome to the ST community,

STM32F3 is a 180nm process technology.
forum.content_text: A customer asked for the process technology or process node in nano meters (nm) for the STM32F303CCT7 we use. I can not find any information on ST website. The “Sidekick” told me there is no information about. Can someone help me?
